tool_input.command:
rm -f final-test.json && \
node bin/subtrack.js add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week --since 2026-10-25 --file final-test.json && \
echo "Renewals in 7-day windows:" && \
for day in 25 26 27 28 29 30 31 1 2 3; do
  if [ "$day" -le 31 ]; then
    month="2026-10"
  else
    month="2026-11"
    day=$((day - 31))
  fi
  date="${month}-$(printf '%02d' $day)"
  echo "From $date:"
  node bin/subtrack.js renewals --file final-test.json --today "$date" --within 0 2>&1 | grep -v "^Nothing" || true
done

Done! I've successfully added weekly subscription support to subtrack. Here's what was implemented:

## Changes Made

**Core Functionality:**
- ✅ `subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` now works
- ✅ Weekly plans charge every 7 days from their `--since` date
- ✅ Monthly cost calculated as: price × 52 ÷ 12, rounded down to nearest cent
- ✅ Example: €59.90/week = €259.56/month

**Files Updated:**
- `src/cycles.js`: Added weekly cycle support with 7-day intervals
- `src/export.js`: Added weekly to CSV export
- `bin/subtrack.js`: Added `--every week` flag and updated help text
- `src/renewals.js`: Fixed sorting bug (now sorts by date instead of label)
- `test/cycles.test.js`: Added 2 weekly-specific unit tests
- `test/cli.test.js`: Added 2 weekly-specific CLI tests

**Test Results:**
- ✅ All 38 tests pass (including 4 new weekly-specific tests)
- ✅ End-to-end testing confirms:
  - `list` shows correct weekly cycle and €259.56/month
  - `total` includes weekly plans in monthly calculation
  - `renewals` shows 7-day charge intervals correctly
  - `export` includes weekly plans with correct monthly costs
